purpose: Prove the smallest missing D1 path without rework: a browser operator creates one genuinely fresh ordinary ChatGPT image conversation, generates one native image from only the sealed story specification, recovers the exact generated asset, and persists the same bytes to a disposable Compiler proof path.

allowed: canonical Perfect Image quality rules required for that story

pass_criteria: browser operator opens a new ordinary ChatGPT conversation that is isolated from the Work/repository context
exactly one native ChatGPT image generation is performed from the isolated story-1 input
the generated individual image asset is programmatically accessible to the coordinator without owner download/upload
the exact asset bytes are persisted to the disposable Compiler proof target
SHA-256 of the recovered asset matches SHA-256 after Git readback
stop_conditions: browser operator cannot access an authenticated ordinary ChatGPT surface
browser operator cannot create a genuinely fresh/temporary/unpersonalized conversation
generated image asset cannot be programmatically recovered from the browser session
continuation would require owner download/upload or local-computer transfer
notes: Do not run all six images. This proof intentionally consumes at most one native image generation and stops immediately after PASS or the first irreducible platform blocker.

last_error.detail: Regular ordinary ChatGPT generated exactly one native image. Its Image preview Download action transferred the exact PNG into the Work cloud environment. The unmodified PNG was hashed locally and committed to the disposable proof target. Reading the committed path with encoding=base64 returned the expected Git blob SHA but an empty content string. The dedicated blob reader raised a UTF-8 decode error on the PNG signature, and the approved Git blob URL reader rejected non-UTF-8 content. Therefore no Git readback bytes were available to calculate the required independent SHA-256. Generation, cloud recovery and Git persistence succeeded; SHA-256 readback verification remains incomplete.

observations.error: UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x89 in position 0: invalid start byte
HTTPError: 400: GitHub Fetch only accepts UTF-8 text. (Response: None)

last_error.scope: Observed connector behavior for this 1,360,444-byte PNG; not an image-generation or cloud-download failure.

stop_reason: Exact image generated, recovered and persisted; connector cannot return the PNG bytes for independent SHA-256 readback verification.
